_meta.note: PARTIAL / BEST-EFFORT list, NOT a full scrape of wizzair.com. Compiled from public web-search summaries (aggregator sites: FlightConnections, Airhex, Brilliant Maps, Wikipedia, etc.) on 2026-07-09, not from the live Wizz Air search form.
_meta.why_partial: Direct network access from this environment to wizzair.com/be.wizzair.com is blocked by sandbox policy, and full-page fetching (WebFetch) was returning 403 for all external sites during this session, so only search-snippet data could be gathered. Search snippets are AI-summarized and not 100% reliable — one code from a snippet (Kutaisi) was verified wrong and corrected below.
_meta.coverage: Only the countries/regions listed here were cross-checked with reasonable confidence. Wizz Air's full network is ~150-190+ airports across 43-50 countries (sources disagree on exact count) - most of it is NOT included below.
_meta.recommendation: For a complete, accurate, current list, run wizzair_route_scraper.py from a machine/environment with normal internet access to wizzair.com.
